sam (Marketing): Quick sync: we need a lean battlecard for launch next Tue. Three competitor buckets: cloud AI, public LLM APIs, infra vendors. One-sentence angle + two SDR lines each.
elaine (Field): Field note: prospects push back with 'we own infra' and 'we have existing cloud contracts'. Need econ + ops painline.
omar (Product): Benchmark rule: avoid exact p99s in external copy. Use 'customer-observed' language and link to appendix. Also add a non-technical explainer of 'fallbacks'.
kai (DemandGen): For webinar hero A/B: Econ-first: "Lower inference spend, maintain quality." Engineer-first: "Unified runtime across deployments 1 minute demo."
sam (Marketing): Micro-rebuts (draft):
- vs cloud AI: "Transparent unit economics + SLA-backed fallbacks."
- vs LLM APIs: "Not just model access  a single runtime for deployment consistency."
- vs infra vendors: "Predictable performance without a large ops team."
elaine (Field): SDR cold opener (short): "Seeing surprises on inference bills? We show you spend per-run and fix tail risk. 15 mins?"
omar (Product): Routing template for HubSpot copy: "intent: compliance -> private-deck; intent: cost -> benchmark-blog; intent: self-host -> dedicated-trial; intent: latency -> perf-demo"
publish-bot: Assets uploaded -> /drive/webinar/launch/v1 (marketing+demandgen+sales)
sam (Marketing): Action items: @kai pick hero variant + ad copy (EOD). @elaine: 3 field bullets (tomorrow AM). @omar: draft fallback explainer slide & routing YAML (after lunch). I'll assemble and post to #sales-assets. Short thread, reply with edits. :rocket:
